Column Guide

Player
Canonical lowercase player key from the project's naming table. Identity is resolved before any pricing — ambiguous names are excluded, never guessed.
Source
Which publisher the value comes from: fantasycalc_adjusted, fantasypros_adjusted, usatoday_adjusted, cbsros, espn, etc. The _adjusted suffix means as-published values run through the adjustment-cell refit.
Season
NFL season year (e.g., 2026).
Week
NFL week number (1–18). All weeks are retained — no aging out.
Scoring
League scoring: full (Full PPR), half (Half PPR), standard (no PPR).
League Members
League size: 8, 10, 12, or 14 members.
QB
QB variant. qb1 / qb2 appear only on FantasyCalc rows — the 1-QB vs 2-QB league variants of that source's value. Everything else stores none, shown as blank: no QB variant is applied, i.e. the value assumes 1-QB leagues. Verified 2026-10-03 against all 20,532 live rows: qb1/qb2 exist only on fantasycalc / fantasycalc_adjusted rows.
View
Which value family each row carries — four numbers for the same player, answering different questions. combo_reindexed: the trade value the source itself published, put on the shared chart scale (what the source actually said, not a model guess). vorp: VORP vs waivers — how much better the player is than a waiver-wire replacement, computed from the eight position-and-role groups. vorp_indexed: each source's own raw trade numbers on the shared 0–70 chart scale; sources that publish only projections have no value here. adj_values: the final chart-ready number — shared 0–70 axis where the best player across every source hits exactly 70 and every source's values add up to the same overall budget.
Value
The exact final value — stored unrounded in consolidation. Rounding happens in presentation only.
